SUBJECT: FIELD MANAGERS' COMMENTS - N/E MAY 26, 1978

DAM

Intercin Activity Reporting System

- Managers are increased with this new administrative reporting system and the wealth of information about their territories that will be available. They felt the hot line telephone set up to answer their questions was invaluable.

The most frequent negatives reported were (1) not enough lead time from receipt of general letter to meetings (they were not able to properly prepare for meetings, especially those who travel, and this could result in more reporting errors); (2) there was no provision for keeping up with inventories of LNG/SMP materials which is helpful information in transferring needed supplies within Assignments.
